summary: Equinox Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release regarding a proposed business combination (arrangement) with Orla Mining Ltd. The filing updates that proxy advisory firms ISS and others recommend Equinox Gold shareholders vote FOR the share issuance resolution needed to complete the deal, originally announced May 13, 2026. Both boards unanimously recommend the arrangement. A special meeting is set for July 22, 2026. Terms such as price, premium, and consideration are not disclosed in this excerpt. The transaction is a stock-for-stock merger. Watch for shareholder vote outcome and regulatory approvals.
